entries.description: Security reminders applied during Docker Compose generation: reference all secrets via environment variable substitution (${VAR}), limit published ports to those required externally, add persistent volumes only where genuinely needed.
decision_rules: Use ${VAR} syntax for all credentials — values come from .env file or Docker secrets
Only publish ports (host:container) for services that need external access
Add named volumes only for stateful services (databases, caches with persistence requirements)
anti_patterns: Hardcoding passwords, tokens, or API keys directly in docker-compose.yml
Publishing all internal service ports to 0.0.0.0 on the host
Adding unnecessary volumes to stateless API containers
